expectation: Membrane ring on a subset of cells (cytotoxic T cells), scattered singly in tissue, with intraepithelial cells lining epithelium or glands and clusters in lymphoid areas; they should sit within CD3E+ cells, and some NK or DC cells may be dimmer.
observed: A: faint speckle with a large out-of-tissue haze. B: discrete bright ring-shaped cells scattered over a dim background. C: ring cells lined up around a gland or crypt, in the epithelium. D: bright cell clusters, a bit blurred. E1: many distinct membrane rings. E3: most are white, so they overlap CD3E.
why: Discrete membrane-ringed cells sit in an epithelial or intraepithelial pattern and overlap CD3E+ cells, as expected for CD8a.
